option_relations.rationale: Disseminated osteomyelitis secondary to Klebsiella pneumoniae infection is a manifestation of Klebsiella pneumoniae-induced sepsis.
Metastatic hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae infection is a manifestation of Klebsiella pneumoniae-induced sepsis.
Klebsiella pneumoniae liver abscess syndrome is a manifestation of Klebsiella pneumoniae-induced sepsis.

Hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae (hvKp) infection with multifocal manifestations including bacteremia, tibial osteomyelitis, pyogenic liver abscess, and multifocal osteomyelitis is a manifestation of Klebsiella pneumoniae-induced sepsis.
